llm.summary: This is a coherent self-hosted speech-to-text helper, but users should understand that audio files and URL downloads can be stored on the talkies server.

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the stated ASR purpose: transcribing uploaded or URL-based audio, producing subtitles/JSON/text, managing loaded models, and exposing an MCP interface for the same operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly documents file upload, URL file_path downloads, server-side staging, file listing/retrieval/deletion, auth behavior, and deployment hardening; these are broad within the talkies data directory but purpose-aligned and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is Docker-based using the publisher's talkies images, with a helper shell script that sends user-specified files or URLs to TALKIES_URL; no hidden post-install hook, obfuscation, or unrelated command execution was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Docker, curl, network access, model downloads, GPU/CPU resources, bearer-token configuration, and persisted model/data directories are proportionate for a self-hosted transcription server. Public deployments require explicit hardening.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The service persists model weights plus staged uploads and URL download caches under TALKIES_DATA_DIR and exposes cleanup endpoints for those files. This is expected for the feature set, but access should be controlled on shared or public servers.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to run or connect to a talkies server. Treat uploaded audio, staged files, transcripts, and cached remote downloads as potentially sensitive server-side data. Keep the service bound to localhost or a trusted network when possible; if exposed, set TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN, use TLS/rate limiting, and enable TALKIES_BLOCK_PRIVATE_DOWNLOADS for untrusted clients. Clean up staged files and cached downloads when they are no longer needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact supports the underlying privacy concern because URL-based transcription is downloaded and cached server-side. However, the behavior is repeatedly documented, includes file listing/deletion details and size limits, and is coherent with the stated caching/staging feature, so it does not justify Review by itself.
[VirusTotal.clean] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this is consistent with the inspected artifacts but was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
[staticScan.clean] expected: The available static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and manual inspection found no hidden persistence, credential exfiltration, destructive host actions, or unrelated behavior.
